items.name: Liam Gardner
items.quote: I’ve been working with Diana since 2023, she is by far the best Pilates instructor I’ve ever worked with. Her knowledge and dedication to the discipline is top notch, her experience of working with all types of populations is evident in the way she is able to adapt any session, especially for me to match my needs after a back injury. I could not recommend her more!

items.name: Lila Male
items.quote: I absolutely love my private Pilates sessions with her! She’s so sweet, encouraging, and makes every session feel personalized to me. She really takes the time to focus on my form and help me improve. I always leave feeling amazing, and I would definitely recommend her to anyone looking for a Pilates instructor! 💗

items.name: Ida
items.quote: I’ve been practicing Pilates for many years, and what sets Diana apart is her thoughtful, detail-oriented approach to teaching. She has a unique ability to identify areas for improvement in real time, offering guidance that helps you deepen your awareness, refine your technique, and discover new ways to challenge yourself. With her instruction, I’ve continued to progress in ways I hadn’t before. Diana is an excellent instructor who looks beyond the movements themselves to help you get more out of every session. No matter how long you’ve been practicing Pilates, she’ll help you take your practice to the next level!

items.name: Sammi Davis Jr.
items.quote: I've been working with Diana for 2-3 years, and I can't recommend her highly enough. As someone who is hypermobile, I've historically struggled to build strength and often ended up injured after exercise. I'm so thankful that with Diana I've been able to find not only an approach to movement that works for me but also a teaching style that has been so helpful to me. She has helped give me confidence in my body and a much better understanding of how to move it well. Her encouraging attitude, attention to detail, and love for what she does really makes a huge difference and I'm so thankful for it!

items.name: Mike R.
items.quote: Amazing Pilates instructor! Would highly recommend.

items.name: Ronnie Phillips
items.quote: I highly recommend Diana. I have been doing Pilates for almost 7 years and the last 3 with Diana. I had neck, lower back and flexibility issues and she takes her time and works to make sure that you are doing everything correctly to help fix the issues that you have.

items.name: Ken Fogarty
items.quote: Diana has been my Pilates instructor for almost 2 years. I have been doing Pilates for 8 years with dozens of instructors and Diana is unique. Classically trained, she utilizes all of the traditional Pilates exercises but combines them with a deep knowledge of muscle movement, stretching and physiology to create the perfect session. About a year ago I had a bad shoulder that didn’t respond to rest, an Orthopedic’s treatment or physical therapy. Diana’s sessions, which incorporated stretching, medium resistance and certain Pilates movements, markedly improved my range of motion in my shoulder and dramatically reduced the pain. I highly recommend Diana to anyone who wants to start Pilates or wants to improve on their current practice.

items.name: Katina
items.quote: Diana is an absolute gem! She is knowledgeable about Pilates and movement, and her passion for what she does truly shines through in every class. Highly recommend!

items.name: Harlan Lehman
items.quote: Diana is AMAZING. I’m recovering from a torn adductor muscle and it is not fun. She is patient, yet pushes me to try to strengthen my lower core muscles.

items.name: Spencer
items.quote: Diana has been my Pilates instructor for a few months now and is literally the best. I look forward to our sessions every time. She pays attention to every little detail and makes sure your form is correct before anything else. I was brand new to Pilates when I started seeing her and in the past month and a half I have already seen so many improvements in and outside Pilates. I have seen physical changes but also exercises I was struggling with in the beginning I have gotten so much better at and look forward to challenging myself and continuing to improve on new and more difficult exercises. Again, she is truly the best.

items.name: Melissa Gorup
items.quote: Diana is an excellent Pilates instructor who consistently corrects form and provides her clients with positive guidance.

items.name: J B
items.quote: Diana is a great motivator with extensive knowledge. She gave precise instruction and attention to my personal needs.

items.name: Nick Dejesus
items.quote: Diana is a great instructor and helped with my lower back pain!

items.name: Morgan
items.quote: Diana is hands down the best Pilates instructor I’ve ever worked with. She is kind, patient, and knowledgeable. She’s helped me work through mobility issues and has become an invaluable resource for my wellness routine!
